title: Victoria police re-enact single gunshot heard hour after Dezi Freeman fled into Porepunkah bushland
summary: ‘Firearms testing’ triggered by reports of gunshot at about 11.45am on day Freeman is alleged to have killed two police officers serving warrant Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A reported single gunshot has sparked a fresh line of inquiry in the long-running manhunt for alleged police killer Desmond “Dezi” Freeman. Victoria police conducted “firearms testing” near Barrett Lane and Rayner Track in Porepunkah, about 300km north-east of Melbourne, on Wednesday as part of their search. Continue reading...
